questions.question: In electron microprobe analysis, which X-ray lines are most commonly used for compositional analysis?
Which of the following elements is challenging to analyze using EPMA?
In quantitative X-ray metallography, what role does the 'ZAF correction' play when using an electron microprobe analyzer?

answers.a: It adjusts for variations in magnification
answers.b: It compensates for the interaction of X-rays with the detector
answers.c: It corrects for atomic number, absorption, and fluorescence effects
answers.d: It enhances the resolution of the X-ray image

questions.question: In EPMA, what does the term 'wavelength dispersive spectrometry' (WDS) refer to?

answers.a: A method to measure the energy of X-rays
answers.b: A technique to separate X-rays based on their wavelengths using a diffraction crystal
answers.c: A way to increase the spatial resolution of the analysis
answers.d: A type of detector used for secondary electrons

questions.question: What is the primary use of Line Scan Imaging in EPMA?

answers.a: To generate high-resolution surface topography images
answers.b: To analyze the variation in elemental composition along a specific line on the sample
answers.c: To identify defects in the sample's crystal structure
answers.d: To create a 3D model of the sample surface
